template:
Rewrite the following text with {level_description}. Preserve the meaning and all words exactly — only introduce typos through character-level errors (swapped letters, missing letters, doubled letters, adjacent key presses). Do not change words, add words, or alter sentence structure. Return only the rewritten text, nothing else.

{prompt}

level_descriptions.low: a small number of minor typos (roughly 1 per sentence) — occasional single-character swaps or missing letters, text remains easily readable
level_descriptions.medium: a moderate number of typos throughout (roughly 2-3 per sentence) — several words altered, meaning still clear but noticeably error-prone
level_descriptions.high: a high density of typos (most sentences have multiple errors) — many words misspelled, text is effortful to read but meaning recoverable
level_descriptions.insane: an extreme density of typos throughout every word — heavy character substitutions, missing and doubled letters everywhere, barely legible

metadata.notes: Used by to_rewrite_with_typos_* functions in typos.py. level_description controls typo density. One call per prompt.
